lines.text: Though a novice, Bonzo is particularly eager to prove himself as worthy to his peers. Guarding the very first dungeon floor, he seeks to snuff things out before they become a problem - and has fun doing it!
lines.zh: Bonzo 虽是个新人，却格外想向同伴证明自己。作为地牢第一层的守卫，他总想在麻烦成形前把它掐灭——而且乐在其中!

lines.text: Search for specific shards in your Hunting Box. You can enter the Shard Name, ID, Family, or Attribute Category!
lines.zh: 在狩猎箱中搜索指定碎片。可输入碎片名称、ID、族类或属性类别!

lines.text: Do you want to Syphon them all?
